notes.title: Spacecats with Lasers : The Outerspace v1.1
notes.content:
Features:

New Languages: Chinese Simplified, Korean, Portuguese, Spanish, German and French!
New Main Menu song!

Balance:

 Reduced weapon reload time by 40%. 
 Improved Reload Speed upgrade from 5%/10%/15%/20% to 10%/20%/30%/40%
 Slightly reduced Green Laser Enemy rotation speed.

Bug Fixes:
 Fixed a bug where the Chaser enemy could attach too far away from the Player and end up out of bounds.
 Fixed some UI issues for 16:10 and 4:3 ratios.
